messages:
sara.j: Hey support — customer (NovaOrchard) just flagged two invoices for the same renewal period. They say PO #PO-99321 was sent and we also charged the card 2026-03-15.

mike: Ugh. Do we have invoice IDs? customer provided PDF showing two invoices with different numbers but identical amounts.

sara.j: They sent invoice IDs INV-2026-99321 and INV-2026-99321-2 (weird suffix). Attached screenshots in the ticket. Customer says their AP sent PO then also manually paid card because renewal email looked past due.

ashok: Possible race between PO webhook and card retry flow. Which payment method won? Can we see charge IDs?

sara.j: In the ticket: charge_1 = ch_3L9aX, charge_2 = ch_3L9bY. Both show status `succeeded` in stripe logs.

billing-bot: webhook_event: { "type": "po_created", "po_id": "PO-99321", "customer": "novaorchard", "amount_cents": 49900, "timestamp": "2026-03-15T09:02:14Z" }

billing-bot: payment_log: { "event": "card_charged", "charge_id": "ch_3L9bY", "timestamp": "2026-03-15T09:02:44Z", "origin": "manual_retry" }

kate: Looks like webhook processed at 09:02:14 and card charge at 09:02:44 — 30s gap. Our idempotency for PO-created vs charge flow might differ. If PO flow creates invoice and marks subscription as paid, card retry may not check for a just-created invoice with matching period.

mike: Can we repro locally? Steps to reproduce: 1) customer creates PO via API 2) our webhook handler creates invoice immediately 3) manual card retry triggers charging endpoint with `attempt_payment=true` and our code doesn't verify active invoice with same period.

ashok: I dug into handler: in `handle_po_created` we call `create_invoice`, no locking. Meanwhile card retry `attemptCharge` queries `subscription.balance` but only checks `balance > 0` not invoice existence for same billing cycle. Race window allows both.

sara.j: Customer wants immediate reversal of the duplicate charge and a single invoice reflecting PO (their AP requires PO on invoice). Can we refund ch_3L9bY and close INV-2026-99321-2 as duplicate, then reissue credit note linking to INV-2026-99321?

kate: Agree. Ops playbook: refund full charge -> mark duplicate invoice `void` with reason `duplicate_payment` -> create credit_note referencing duplicate invoice -> notify customer and accounting. Will need finance approval for refund if > $10k (this is $499).

mike: I'll trigger refund for ch_3L9bY now and annotate the ticket. Doing `POST /refunds` with body `{ "charge_id":"ch_3L9bY", "reason":"duplicate_charge" }`.

billing-bot: refund_created: { "refund_id": "rf_77X", "charge_id": "ch_3L9bY", "status": "pending", "amount_cents": 49900 }

ashok: After refund completes, we should update invoice state and run cleanup job to prevent re-creation: add idempotency key on PO id and make card retry check for `open_invoice_for_period(subscription, period)` before charging.

sara.j: Customer replied they can wait for refund settlement but need a GAAP-friendly credit note. Also asked for root cause and steps to prevent recurrence.

kate: Action items:
- mike: finish refund and attach refund_id to ticket (in progress)
- ashok: add quick patch to card retry flow to check for same-period invoice (hotfix) — target ROLLOUT today
- sara.j: send AP-friendly credit note once refund settles and confirm PO referenced on official invoice

mike: Refund processed (rf_77X) status now `succeeded`.

billing-bot: refund_update: { "refund_id":"rf_77X","status":"succeeded","processed_at":"2026-03-15T10:12:01Z" }

sara.j: Sent customer the credit note and note that refund succeeded. They asked whether we can give a short write-up for their auditor: "race between PO webhook creating invoice and manual card retry — fixed by adding invoice-existence check and PO idempotency".

ashok: I'll open PR with tests for the hotfix and a short migration to add `po_id` unique constraint on `invoices` table to avoid duplicates. Link to PR when ready.

kate: Thanks team. Assigning follow-up: label `billing-incident` and add to weekly postmortem. Customer happy with refund and documentation, closing ticket once PR merged.

sara.j: Closing loop with customer now. :white_check_mark:
